remarks: This bright two bedroom townhouse is located on a grassy courtyard with mature plantings. The quiet location gives it a sense of privacy. Lovely interior with new vinyl planking floors, neutral interior colors, hi-end kitchen cabinets, new central air system, new washer, dryer, dishwasher and range, sunny eat-in kitchen, finished lower level family room and large utiltiy room with laundry area and plenty of storage. The new CA system had a thermostat that can be controlled via a smartphone. There is convenient street parking in front as well as 1 parking space in the nearby parking lot. Sylvan Knoll is conveniently located off of exit 9 on I-95. It is walking distance to Cove Island Park, the beach and Chelsea Piers, and just a short drive to town, shopping, and the train station. Located on 13 park-like acres with sidewalks throughout, Sylvan Knoll is a pet friendly community. Units are all owner occupied. They cannot be rented. Real estate taxes are included in the common charges.
